reasoning: Both attempts remove the per-frame folder scans, drive counts from ChildAdded and ChildRemoved, rebuild the text only when a count or the hovered block changes, and pass every check. A matches the old behavior a little more exactly (it keeps the tie order) and uses the grid-cell lookup the rubric names, but it needs much more code and caches block positions. B gets the same scaling with a short, idiomatic spatial query that reads live block positions, and its report is more explicitly honest: it marks the after numbers as unmeasured and adds a profile label that makes the result easy to verify. Overall, B is the better change for a Roblox developer to merge, by a small margin.

The grid index scales with constant cost
